label: Google Drive Watch
description: Fires an execution when a watched Drive file or folder changes. Google delivers change notifications by pushing to your weft, so your weft must be reachable from the internet (locally: ./setup.sh --public-url), and the address must belong to a domain verified in the app's Google console. The watch is renewed automatically for as long as the trigger is active.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: The Google access (wire a GoogleAccess node). The account needs at least read access to the watched file.

inputs.name: target
inputs.label: File or folder
inputs.placeholder: Pick one, or paste its link

inputs.name: changes
inputs.label: Change kinds
inputs.description: Which changes fire: any change, only content edits, only property/metadata changes, or only children added/removed (folders).
